weather.title: Weather & Crop Advice
weather.subtitle: Tell us your area and we will tell you what the weather means for your field today.
weather.geoDenied: Location not available. Choose your district from the list below — your farm advice will still work.
weather.confirmSubtitle: We will give weather advice for this place.
weather.checking: Checking the weather for your field…
weather.normalSummary: Weather looks fine — no big warning for today. You can do your routine farm work.

warn.rainHigh: There is a {p}% chance of rain in the next 24 hours — this can spoil fresh irrigation or a spray.
warn.waterlog: Heavy rain ({rain} mm) may fall — waterlogging or crop lodging (falling over) is possible in standing crops.
warn.heat: Heat may reach {temp}°C — avoid fieldwork in the afternoon and water early morning or evening only.
warn.wind: Wind may blow at {wind} km/h — do not spray (the chemical will drift away), and tall or flowering crops could get physical damage.
warn.fungal: High humidity ({humidity}%) with 20–30°C temperature — fungal disease risk can rise in the next two days. Keep an eye on leaves, this is not a diagnosis.
warn.dry: No rain expected for about {days} days and heat up to {temp}°C — crops can face water stress. Use water carefully.
warn.swing: Weather is changing (about {delta}°C difference from yesterday) — keep a close watch on the crop.

act.rainNoSpray: Do not irrigate or spray today — rain may come and wash it away.
act.drainCheck: Keep drainage channels clear so water does not stand in the field.
act.heatTiming: Give water early morning or evening, not in the afternoon heat.
act.windNoSpray: Do not spray in strong wind — the chemical can drift and be wasted.
act.fungalWatch: Check under the leaves daily; if white or brown spots spread, ask an expert.
act.waterSave: Save water — no rain is expected in the coming days.
act.swingWatch: Walk the field daily while the weather keeps changing.
act.normalDay: No special action needed — continue routine care of the crop.

farm.fieldTitle: Select your field on the map
farm.fieldSubtitle: Zoom into your farm and tap the map to mark the corners of your field. The map is satellite imagery — your phone's GPS is only a starting point.
farm.cropTitle: Which crop is in your field?
farm.cropSubtitle: Choose the crop you have planted — this helps us give better advice.
farm.drawHint: Tap on the map to add points around your field. Finish with at least 3 points.
farm.ndviLegend: Vegetation index — less green → more green
farm.satelliteDaysAgo: Latest clear satellite image available: {days} days ago.
farm.satelliteDaysAgoOne: Latest clear satellite image available: 1 day ago.
farm.satelliteUnavailable: Satellite data is not available right now.
farm.satelliteSourceDown: The satellite data source did not respond. Showing only what is available — nothing is guessed.
farm.noFieldHint: Draw your field on the map so we can measure vegetation with satellite data.
farm.agroWaiting: Field satellite data will appear here once your field and crop are ready.
farm.agroUnavailable: Field satellite data is not available right now. Try again later.
farm.agroNotConfigured: Field satellite service is not connected. Add AGROMONITORING_API_KEY to .env.
farm.agroImageAlt: Latest satellite image of your field
farm.satelliteObservationLine: This is the latest available observation — satellite images are not live video.
farm.agroEstimateNote: Satellite-derived vegetation indicator — it estimates greenness and can suggest possible stress. It is not a disease diagnosis.
farm.agroSoilNote: Soil values are a model estimate from the satellite service — not a ground measurement. Treat as a guide only.
farm.cropHealthWaiting: Select your field and crop first, then refresh satellite data.
farm.satelliteHonesty: This is a satellite-derived vegetation indicator — it estimates greenness and can suggest possible stress. It is NOT a disease diagnosis, and it cannot measure exact soil water. For a specific problem, use Check a Crop Photo or ask an expert.
farm.soilMoistureNote: Exact soil moisture cannot be confirmed from this satellite image. The advice above uses weather + satellite indicators only.

warn.rainWaterlog: {p}% rain chance with about {rain} mm expected — if water stands in your field, drainage matters. Standing water can harm many crops.
warn.dryHot: No rain expected for about {days} days and heat up to {temp}°C — crops can face water stress. Check the field before watering.
warn.ndviDecline: The vegetation index has dropped by about {delta} points compared with the previous satellite observation. Possible reasons to check: water, weather, pest/disease or nutrient problem — satellite alone cannot pick one.
warn.ndviImprove: The vegetation index rose by about {delta} points compared with the previous observation — greenery looks better than before.

act.drain: Keep drainage channels clear so water does not stand in the field.
act.waterCheck: Check soil moisture by hand before watering — heat and no rain can dry the field fast.
act.noSprayRainWind: Do not spray today — strong wind plus expected rain will waste the chemical.
act.noSprayWind: Do not spray in strong wind — the chemical can drift away.
act.checkReasons: Walk the field and check leaves, soil and weather. If a specific problem is visible, use Check a Crop Photo.
act.routine: No special action needed — continue routine care of the crop.

card.weatherRain: Today about {t}°C with a {p}% chance of rain — keep that in mind for fieldwork.
card.weatherClear: Today about {t}°C, no significant rain expected right now.
card.rainInDays: Rain may come in about {days} day(s) according to the forecast.
card.rainNone: No significant rain expected in the next 7 days.
card.waterSkip: Rain chance is {p}% — wait before irrigating so the rain is not wasted.
card.waterCheck: Heat up to {temp}°C and no rain expected — check if the field needs water.
card.waterStress: Satellite shows low vegetation greenness — check water, weather or other reasons before assuming.
card.waterRoutine: No clear sign that watering is urgent right now — decide by looking at the field.
card.healthInsufficient: Not enough satellite data for this field to judge vegetation health.
card.healthOk: Satellite shows healthy green vegetation over your field.
card.healthOkDeclining: Vegetation looks green but the index is falling compared with the previous observation — keep watching.
card.healthWatch: Vegetation index is moderate — keep an eye out; not an alarm.
card.healthStress: Satellite shows low vegetation greenness — possible stress. Check possible reasons (water, weather, pests, nutrients).

photo.title: Check a Crop Photo
photo.subtitle: Take a clear photo of the affected leaf or plant in daylight. We give a first opinion — not a final diagnosis.
photo.analyzingDetail: This can take 20–30 seconds. Please wait.
photo.chooseFirst: First choose or take a photo.
photo.imageTooBig: The photo could not be prepared for sending. Please choose another one.
photo.sendError: Could not send the photo. The internet may be slow — please try again.

quality.tooDark: The photo is too dark. Please retake it in good light.
quality.tooBlurry: The photo is blurry. Hold the camera steady and retake it.
quality.tooSmall: The plant is too far / too small in the photo. Go closer and retake.
quality.generic: The photo is not clear enough. Please retake it in good light.

photo.seekExpert: This may be serious or unclear. Please contact your Krishi Vigyan Kendra or an agriculture expert before spending on any treatment.
photo.lowConfidenceMsg: The image is not sufficient for a reliable diagnosis. Please upload a clearer photo or consult a local agriculture expert/KVK.
photo.productDoseWarning: This app never gives a dose. Confirm the correct product, dose and waiting period with your KVK/agriculture expert and follow the label.
photo.plantIdDisagree: A second automated check (Plant.id) disagrees with this analysis. Treat this result as unconfirmed — verification by a KVK/agriculture expert is required before any action.
photo.notGuaranteed: Not a guaranteed diagnosis. For serious crop damage, verify with a KVK/agriculture expert.
photo.tooManyPhotos: You can send up to {n} photos at once.
photo.qualityTooPoor: Photo not clear enough — remove it or take a better one
photo.maxPhotosReached: Maximum {n} photos added. Remove one to add another.
photo.badPhotoNotice: One or more photos are not clear enough. Remove them or retake them — analysis only uses the clear photos.
photo.notConfiguredTitle: AI photo analysis is not connected yet
photo.notConfiguredFarmer: We are not able to analyse photos right now because the AI service is not connected. Please try again later, or visit your Krishi Vigyan Kendra for help.
photo.notConfiguredDev: For developers: add GEMINI_API_KEY (or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY) to your .env file and restart the app. See SETUP-REPORT-PHOTO.md. Real results only appear when the API call succeeds — this app never shows fake results.
photo.emptyDesc: Take or upload a photo of your crop here. We will tell you right away what problem it could be.

chat.title: Ask a Question
chat.subtitle: Ask in your own words — about weather, a crop problem, or a photo you just checked. We answer simply and honestly.
chat.voiceUnsupported: Voice typing is not supported in this browser — please type your question.
chat.error: Could not get an answer just now. Please try again.
chat.disclaimer: Guidance only — never use a chemical dose mentioned here without an expert's advice.
quickQuestions: Should I spray today or not?
When should I water my crop?
Leaves are turning yellow — what should I do?
chat.contextPhoto: Sharing the crop photo you just checked
chat.photoNotConfigured: Photo analysis is not connected (add GEMINI_API_KEY to .env). You can still chat.
chat.summaryRequest: Please give me the short summary of this conversation.

market.title: Mandi Prices (मंडी भाव)
market.subtitle: Live rates and arrivals from official Agmarknet data — the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India.
market.unitNote: Prices in ₹/quintal · arrivals in metric tonnes.
market.trendLabel: price trend over the last week
market.showingTop: Showing the most active markets — the full list is on Agmarknet.
market.noReportHint: No mandi reported this crop for the selected state in the last 3 months. Choose another crop or state.
market.agmarknetNoteTitle: Where does this data come from?
market.agmarknetNote: Prices and arrivals are fetched live from the official Agmarknet portal of the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India and show the most recent report for each mandi. Tap refresh to sync.

soil.title: Soil Testing (मिट्टी जाँच)
soil.subtitle: Read your Soil Health Card or field-kit results — understand each value and what to do next.
soil.howTo: Enter the values printed on your Soil Health Card (or from a field test kit). Even one value gives useful guidance.
soil.enterHint: As printed on the card / kit
soil.needOne: Enter at least one value from your soil test.
soil.noteBottom: This interpretation follows ICAR and Soil Health Card bands. It is guidance, not a prescription — any chemical application must follow the advice printed on your Soil Health Card or from your KVK.
soil.notEntered: Not entered — no guidance for this value.

notes.phLow: Sour soil — crops like wheat and mustard grow poorly here without correction.
notes.phFine: Almost neutral — most crops grow well.
notes.phHigh: Slightly alkaline — iron and zinc may become less available.
notes.phVeryHigh: High alkalinity — many nutrients become locked. Needs proper reclamation.
notes.ecNormal: Salt level is safe for farming.
notes.ecSaline: Salt level is rising — roots may struggle to take up water.
notes.ecVerySaline: High salt — yield loss is likely without drainage/reclamation.
notes.ocLow: Soil is low in organic matter — it holds less water and nutrients.
notes.ocMedium: Organic matter is moderate — keep adding compost or manure.
notes.ocHigh: Good organic matter — the soil will hold water and nutrients well.
notes.nutrientLow: Below the healthy band — the crop may show deficiency.
notes.nutrientMedium: In the medium band — normal guidance applies.

treat.phLow: Ask your KVK about adding lime (javan/chuana) — do not overdo without a soil test.
treat.phHigh: Ask your KVK about gypsum or sulfur for alkaline soil, and apply more organic matter.
treat.saline: Improve drainage, use organic matter, and ask about gypsum before the monsoon.
treat.ocLow: Add well-rotted farmyard manure, compost or green manure every season.
treat.nutrientLow: Follow your Soil Health Card's fertiliser advice — split doses work best for nitrogen.
treat.allGood: Your soil banding looks healthy. Keep adding organic matter and test again next season.

summary.good: Your soil looks healthy for most crops.
summary.needsCare: Some of your soil values need attention — see the suggestions below.

soil.shcFree: Free soil test every 2 years under Soil Health Card — open official portal
soil.kvkContact: Free doorstep advice and soil-test guidance from your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra

schemes.title: Government Schemes
schemes.subtitle: Active central schemes for farmers with official application links — in simple language.
schemes.note: Every scheme below links to the official government portal where you should actually apply. Benefit amounts and deadlines change by government notification — the official portal is always the final word.
schemes.applyAtBank: KCC is a bank scheme — visit your nearest bank branch with proof of land and identity.

errors.network: The internet is slow or not working. Please try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
